about: The frosting role list. This file is the single source of truth: the CSS, the gallery's derive(), the readability checks, the catalog page and the spec all read from it. Add a role here, nowhere else.

groups.core: Always present. Every frosted page uses these.
groups.status: Optional. Dashboards and monitors: dots, meters, badges.
groups.series: Optional. Chart lines and bars, in order of use.
groups.tag: Optional. Telling projects or categories apart: a strip, an underline, a dot. Shapes, not text.

roles.name: bg
roles.label: Background
roles.use: The page or window background.

roles.name: surface
roles.label: Surface
roles.use: Cards, panels, soft surfaces that sit on the background.

roles.name: border
roles.label: Border
roles.use: Lines, dividers, card edges.

roles.name: text
roles.label: Text
roles.use: Main reading text.

roles.name: muted
roles.label: Quiet text
roles.use: Secondary text, labels, captions. Still has to be readable.

roles.name: accent
roles.label: Accent
roles.use: Shapes, icons, highlights, the logo. Not for body text.

roles.name: accent-text
roles.label: Accent text
roles.use: Accent-coloured text and links. A readable cousin of accent.

roles.name: button
roles.label: Button
roles.use: Primary action fill.

roles.name: button-text
roles.label: Button text
roles.use: Text on the primary button.

roles.name: progress-fill
roles.label: Progress fill
roles.use: The filled part of meters and progress bars.

roles.name: progress-track
roles.label: Progress track
roles.use: The empty part of meters and progress bars.

roles.name: ok
roles.label: OK
roles.use: Healthy, up, done. Dots, meters, badge fills.

roles.name: warn
roles.label: Warning
roles.use: Needs attention soon.

roles.name: bad
roles.label: Bad
roles.use: Down, failed, over the line.

roles.name: series-1
roles.label: Series 1
roles.use: First chart line or bar.

roles.name: series-2
roles.label: Series 2
roles.use: Second chart line or bar.

roles.name: series-3
roles.label: Series 3
roles.use: Third chart line or bar.

roles.name: series-4
roles.label: Series 4
roles.use: Fourth chart line or bar.

roles.name: tag-1
roles.label: Tag 1
roles.use: Project or category tag 1 (blue). Strips, underlines, dots.

roles.name: tag-2
roles.label: Tag 2
roles.use: Project or category tag 2 (orange). Strips, underlines, dots.

roles.name: tag-3
roles.label: Tag 3
roles.use: Project or category tag 3 (violet). Strips, underlines, dots.

roles.name: tag-4
roles.label: Tag 4
roles.use: Project or category tag 4 (green). Strips, underlines, dots.

roles.name: tag-5
roles.label: Tag 5
roles.use: Project or category tag 5 (magenta). Strips, underlines, dots.

roles.name: tag-6
roles.label: Tag 6
roles.use: Project or category tag 6 (cyan). Strips, underlines, dots.

roles.name: tag-7
roles.label: Tag 7
roles.use: Project or category tag 7 (amber). Strips, underlines, dots.

roles.name: tag-8
roles.label: Tag 8
roles.use: Project or category tag 8 (lime). Strips, underlines, dots.

derived.about: Follow the roles automatically through color-mix(); never edited directly. {p} is the prefix.
